summary: Specifies the Bootstrap Router (BSR) mechanism for PIM sparse-style multicast protocols. BSR is one way for a multicast router to learn the group-to-Rendezvous-Point mappings it needs in order to work. Candidate routers advertise themselves and an elected bootstrap router distributes the information. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Multicast routers need to know which meeting-point router handles each group. BSR is a way to pick a leader that announces the list of meeting points to everyone.

questions: how do routers learn rendezvous points
